Press Release
Applications are invited for the Case Worker post on a contractual
basis in the Erode District Bus Stand Child Help Line Unit (1098) functioning
under the District Child Protection Unit - Department of Child Welfare and
Special Services.
Vacant posts & Consolidated Pay
S.
No Post and Salary Eligibility Criteria Age Limit
1
Case Worker
(1-Post)
@Rs.18,000/-
p.m.
• 12th passed from a recognized Board/
Equivalent Board.
• Good Communication Skills.
• Weightage for experienced candidate.
• Preference may be given to
personnel’s of working in Emergency
Helplines.
Age-Not
exceeding 42
years
➢ The application format and eligibility criteria can be downloaded from
erode.nic.in.
➢ Eligible candidates for the above-mentioned post should send their
respective filled applications along with their Passport size Photo and
required certificates xerox copy to the below mentioned address on
or before 12.11.2026 at 5:00 PM.
District Child Protection Officer,
District Child Protection Unit,
Additional Building – 6th Floor,
Collector Office,
Erode – 638011.
➢ The incomplete or unduly filled applications or the applications which
does not reach this office within the stipulated time or late submission
will not be accepted at any cause.
➢ The appointment will be based purely on merit and experience. The
decision of the Government will be final in this regard.
